findings.finding: PAPER 095's formula 'no neural material' is false for this paper. The screen substrate is a human brain cDNA library — 'The filters are PVDF membranes that contain 27 648 human brain cDNA clones arrayed and spotted in duplicate' — expressed as bacterial fusion proteins. The true statement is that there is no neural cell, tissue or system, and that the one neural element is that library.

findings.finding: CLAIM 007's Summary names 'two PPPY-containing oligopeptides (Dvl2 and Wbp1)' and names PMID 15064722 as mechanism primary in the same sentence. DVL2 is NOT among this paper's candidates (WBP-1, SIMPLE/PIG7, NF-kB AP, COTE1, and one clone never identified). An unscoped Role invites the merge of two sources, one of which never measured Dvl2.
findings.direction: OVERSHOOT — Role must scope the paper as primary for the PPxY/Group-I ligand-class logic and the WW1 requirement, and state that the Dvl2 limb is PAPER 007's.

findings.severity: harness gap, T0, not a scientific delta
findings.finding: The check cannot distinguish 'cited as support' from 'cited as contrast': it collects PMIDs from Summary, Source and every Evidence boundary field and resolves them against Claim links with no polarity analysis of the sentence the PMID sits in. Its own declared_claim_links deliberately handles a refusal expressed on the PAPER side ('none — deliberately none. CLAIM 002 and CLAIM 004 must NOT be linked'), precisely because two existing parsers misread it; the same refusal expressed on the CLAIM side has no equivalent handling. Consequence: the CLAIM 036 line is unrepairable by design and will warn forever, which is how a WARN_BUT_PROCEED check gets ignored.
findings.direction: Needs a declared-exception route — an inline contrast marker the parser honours, or a small declared list with a reason per pair, in the shape of the existing grandfather snapshots. Endorsed as a harness finding; not a reason to hold this batch.

findings.reviewed: LIT-0401 'Bendinelli 2017 HGF/Met bone metastasis — RETRACTED', Status: archived, the validator's single unmapped record
findings.finding: Two findings in opposite directions. (a) The erasure argument as given is overstated: the integrity semantics do not live in Status but in Source type ('retracted publication'), Flags ('RETRACTED / invalid evidence / western-blot integrity / category-5 urgent'), Next action ('never use as evidence'), Working Model impact ('source excluded') and the Note. Mapping Status would erase none of it. (b) The conclusion is nonetheless right, on a better ground: Status is the one field every automated consumer keys on, and mapping 'archived' to 'background_only' would make a retracted primary indistinguishable from ordinary context — a collision that is not hypothetical, since LIT-0085, the dependency-contaminated derivative of this very retraction, already sits on background_only. 'filtered_out' describes a relevance decision, not an integrity verdict. Measured: 7 LIT records touch retraction/integrity; 'archived' is unique to LIT-0401 across the whole log.
findings.direction: Add one value to the table ('retracted' or 'integrity_excluded'), defined as excluded on publication-integrity grounds, never evidence, retained permanently for dedup and dependency auditing, and migrate LIT-0401 onto it. The table lives in a scientific current file, so this is a BATCH_COMMIT act and the Orchestrator's decision under §21d — NOT operator-reserved, since §21e names the fundamental guarantees exhaustively and a registry vocabulary is not among them. Safe default meanwhile: leave it; it is grandfathered as the single NOT_IN_VOCABULARY record and warns without blocking, so nothing forces this into today's batch. Caution: lit_status migrate changes 46 records including yesterday's two and is far outside this batch's perimeter.

CONSULTATION_RESULT.r4_answer: NOT required for the promotion. The four mandatory triggers are: a reading that narrows/reverses/corroborates/removes a consolidated baseline claim; a MAJOR declaration; a door-closing rejection; or a reading that contradicts/corrects/replaces a persisted verbatim locator (Annex C.1 gives the last an R4 floor). The third needs care because CLAIM 007 IS a consolidated baseline and 'corroborates' is explicitly a trigger — but that corroboration already had its R4 under ALDAZ-REPAIR-A-20260913 over seven triples, and this delta adds no claim-side assertion: promotion is a registry-identity act. THE CONDITION THAT WOULD TRIGGER IT, stated so it is not discovered later: if the batch lands new text inside CLAIM 007's own fields (the candidate's §2 proposes additions to Source and Genotype/model relevance), that is the third trigger and R4 is owed on the added text unless it is shown per sentence to be within the audited/verified set.
CONSULTATION_RESULT.major: NO. No claim reversed, narrowed, removed or re-typed; no claim Status moved; no BLOCCO 1 change; no baseline reversal. One PAPER created, one placeholder annotated append-only, one LIT record completed, two Claim links fields extended.
CONSULTATION_RESULT.operator_reserved: NOTHING. §21d's RESERVED list is publication to a remote, history rewrite, irreversible deletion of unique material, a change to a fundamental guarantee (that list, §21c, §21d, §21e, plus CLAUDE.md §0's three binding facts), external spend above the default, and private-data exposure. This delta touches none: the placeholder is preserved rather than deleted, which is the append-only carve-out working as designed. The LIT vocabulary addition of F-11 is likewise a BATCH_COMMIT act, not an operator one.
